*   **Multi-resolution Hash Table:** A set of hash tables, one for each resolution level $l \in \{0, \dots, L-1\}$, mapping 3D coordinates to learnable feature vectors [S1].

The claim states that the method uses a set of hash tables, one for each resolution level, mapping 3D coordinates to learnable feature vectors. Additionally, it mentions optimizing 'multi-resolution hash encodings from coarse to fine,' which implies the existence of tables for different resolution levels. The mapping of 3D coordinates to these vectors is the standard definition of hash encoding/tables in this context (Instant-NGP), and the text confirms the use of 'multi-resolution hash tables of learnable feature vectors' for the neural surface representation.
